# Explosion

Explosion shockwaves: clients draw an expanding distortion ring from the epicentre, and the server shoves mobs, items
and unanchored objects outward to the same reach. Strength and reach are set in `ShockwaveCVars`.

Entry points: `ExplosionShockwaveEvent` (broadcast once when an explosion's size is known),
`ExplosionShockwavePushSystem` (server push) and `ExplosionShockwaveSystem` with `ExplosionShockwaveOverlay` (client
ring, `shockwave.swsl`).
